findings_qualitative.value: CO alone is not a viable mass tracer because abundance is degenerate with H2 surface density; HD breaks the degeneracy

evidence.quote: CO alone is not a viable mass tracer as its abundance is degenerate with the total $\textrm{H}_{2}$ surface density.

findings_qualitative.value: 12CO 2-1, 3-2 and 13CO 3-2 trace layers where HD emits; C18O and 13CO 6-5 become optically thin beyond 20-40 AU

evidence.quote: The model agrees well with all seven resolved CO lines available along with the HD J=1-0 flux, and the SED profile

why_this_method.value: Forward modeling with multiple spatially resolved lines gives finer constraints on radial and vertical temperature
